import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[0]
    av = np.abs(v)
    return (params[1]*np.cos(w*t)*av**params[2] + params[3]*np.sin(w*t)*av**params[4]
            + params[5]*v + params[6]*v*np.abs(v) + params[7] + params[8]*np.cos(w*t) + params[9]*np.sin(w*t))
